Name: Dial Countdown
Author: Mate Wish Key

Actions.Name: Countdown
Actions.Tooltip: A countdown timer on a dial. Tap the screen to pause or resume, tap twice to reset it to full, hold to load the next preset, and turn to adjust — the step changes gear every ten clicks the same way.

Actions.Name: Countdown (Key)
Actions.Tooltip: The same countdown timer on an ordinary key. Press to pause or resume, press twice to reset it to full, hold to load the next preset.

Description: Countdown timers for the Stream Deck + dials and for ordinary keys. Tap to pause or resume, tap twice to reset, hold for the next preset — and on a dial, turn to adjust, with a step that changes gear every ten clicks in the same direction.
